name: 53913 · Baraboo, WI
findings: ZIP 53913 (Baraboo) has 88 nonprofit organizations. 47 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 39 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53913 (Baraboo) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 53913 (Baraboo) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 26 organizations here; 22% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
